summary: Master control: register 0x000200 holds one enable bit for each engine and subdevice (nv50_mc_init writes 0xffffffff to it, with the source comment 'everything enabled'), registers 0x000100, 0x000140 and 0x000640 report, arm and mask the interrupt of each unit, and register 0x000260 is written 0 and then 1 around the microcode upload of the GR engine (purpose not known). The Haiku driver must enable the units it uses and route their interrupts.

init.what: Writes 0xffffffff to register 0x000200, the enable bits of all engines and subdevices

intr.what: Reference to the gt215 interrupt handler table providing pending block allow unarm rearm

intr.pending.what: Reads per-engine interrupt status from MMIO 0x0100 and returns whether any interrupt is pending

intr.unarm.what: Writes 0 to MMIO 0x0140 per engine to disable interrupt auto-rearm then reads to clear

intr.rearm.what: Writes 0x00000001 to MMIO 0x0140 per engine to acknowledge and rearm interrupt status

intr.block.what: Writes zero mask to MMIO 0x0640 per engine leaf to block specified interrupt bits

intr.allow.what: Writes mask to MMIO 0x0640 per engine leaf to allow specified interrupt bits to pass

intrs.what: Array of interrupt mapping data defining engine-to-interrupt routing configuration

intr_nonstall.what: Flags that non-stall interrupts are enabled for this GPU interrupt controller

reset.what: Data table of reset register mappings used to reinitialise GPU subsystem registers

device.what: Reference to the nv04 device management sub-table providing enable disable enabled checks

device.enabled.what: Reads register 0x000200 and checks that the enable bits of one engine or subdevice are set

device.enable.what: Sets the mask bits in register 0x000200 to enable one engine or subdevice, then reads the register back

device.disable.what: Clears the mask bits in register 0x000200 to disable one engine or subdevice

unk260.what: Writes data to register 0x000260; the GR engine calls it with 0 before and 1 after the microcode upload (purpose not known)
